entries.notes: 「疾」字与 M 音 iam、R 音 gan 不尽相合（疑「熱」形近之讹或别作「干寒」），依西语 calor y frio 与「寒」字定释义。

entries.en: warm heat that scorches; to heat and burn

entries.zh: 处暑（节气名，谓暑热天时）
entries.en: Chǔshǔ solar term; hot season, hot weather

entries.zh: 火炎；炎热如火（酷热天气）
entries.en: blazing heat like fire; hot, sultry weather
quiet; to be silent and keep still

entries.zh: 金口（金嘴）；谓人讷言，话少而言贵
entries.en: 'golden mouth': a man of few but good words, sparing of speech

entries.zh: 詈语「含蛤」〔字疑：合/含〕：谓口中含妇人之阴，讥其阴郁而口出恶言
entries.en: vulgar insult, lit. 'to hold the clam (a woman's privities) in the mouth': said of one who mopes and speaks ill
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（合/含）；粗鄙詈语，据西语释义直译定诂。

entries.zh: 詈语「含茄」〔字疑：含/合〕：谓口中含男根，故默不作声
entries.en: vulgar insult, lit. 'to hold the eggplant (the male member) in the mouth': hence keeping silent
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（含/合）；西语词头末「me.」疑为截断，语义据前条同类詈语推定。

entries.zh: 滋润；谓人温润安逸、心平少言
entries.en: moist, nourished; of a person at ease — mild, quiet, speaking little
entries.notes: 「滋潤」本义湿润滋养，与西语 gloss（沉静少言）有距离，取其安逸/温润之引申义，故降级。
汉字栏[残]；西语词头讹乱（calle, numeral joilos, vjatta），四栏无从互证。
汉字栏残缺仅辨「倒街」，M/R 音写互歧；西语谓『人多之街、上有物坠落』，词形语义皆难定。

entries.zh: （手足上的）老茧；胼胝〔字疑：癣/瘌〕
entries.en: callus on the feet or hands; hardened skin
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（癣/瘌），据西语 callo（手足之茧）定诂。
